Title: API Management’s Named Values integration with Azure Key Vault

Body.Content:
With the preview of API Management’s Named Values integration with Azure Key Vault, API Management’s Named Values can now be stored and managed in Azure Key Vault.

With this integration, customers can: 

  • Reference Azure Key Vault secrets shared across various services as Named Values. 
  • Manage and rotate Named Values in Azure Key Vault. 
  • Specify granular access policies for Named Values stored in Azure Key Vault. 

Storing and managing Named Values secrets in Azure Key Vault increases service security.

Learn more.
